note: Set A binds values to named components more consistently (cap plate 4 X 3/8", angle L3x3x1/4 with (2) 3/4" bolts, 3" STD pipe, 4 1/2x4 1/2x1/2 plate, 1 1/2" hole, PL5x4x3/8 TYP), while Set B repeatedly leaves the entity vague ('component', 'Detail', bare 'crane attachment | dimension') and misreads 2" TYP as a plate dimension. Both sets invent or misplace detail conditions: A assigns 3/4" HOLE and 1'-4 1/4" to the wrong details, calls 3" TYP and 2" TYP PV-post base-plate dimensions (they belong to the A3 cantilever detail), and adds an unsupported 'from T.O. STEEL to top of cap plate' condition to 1'-8". B's errors are more numerous in kind (3/8" as a crane-attachment dimension, truncated '3/4" D' condition, duplicated plate claims), so A is the better set overall despite its detail misattributions. Neither set captures the PL 3"X3/8"X1'-6" plate called out twice on the sheet.
